strengths.text: Excellent natural shielding and reliable water deposits.

weaknesses.text: The enclosed terrain restricts views and surface mobility.

opportunities.text: Lava tubes may allow low-cost habitat expansion.

threats.text: Isolation and limited daylight may damage crew morale.

responses.critical-risk: Psychological strain from darkness, enclosure, and limited access to open terrain.

risk-position.rationale: Technically robust, but human factors need more attention than the proposal currently gives them.

responses.crew-policy: Rotate surface and habitat duties so no crew member remains in the enclosed habitat for extended periods.
responses.required-change: Redesign communal areas with circadian lighting, private spaces, and regular surface rotations.
